repositories.name: account-service
repositories.evidence: The proposed response-field rename is declared by AddressResponse at account-service/src/main/java/com/poc/account/api/dto/AddressResponse.java:6-18; AddressController returns it from list/get/create/update at account-service/src/main/java/com/poc/account/api/AddressController.java:45-81.

repositories.name: commerce-bff
repositories.evidence: AddressProxyController accepts and returns JsonNode, then relays to account-service at commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/api/AddressProxyController.java:35-69. DownstreamRelay serializes the unbound body and deserializes the response as JsonNode at commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/infrastructure/client/DownstreamRelay.java:40-58, so it transparently exposes postcode to its callers.

repositories.name: commerce-web
repositories.evidence: The SPA's Address type declares postalCode at commerce-web/src/api/types.ts:47-61, and CheckoutPage reads and submits that property at commerce-web/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx:12-20 and commerce-web/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx:112-120.

repositories.name: order-service
repositories.evidence: AccountClient name-binds Account's GET response into a postalCode record component at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/infrastructure/client/AccountClient.java:24-41. A renamed provider property therefore becomes null and is sent to ShipmentClient by CheckoutService at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/application/CheckoutService.java:41-52.

repositories.name: commerce-platform
repositories.evidence: End-to-end address/quote scenarios call the BFF at localhost:8080 (commerce-platform/e2e-bruno/environments/local.bru:2) and retain postalCode in address payloads, e.g. commerce-platform/e2e-bruno/01-signup-to-confirmed-order/04-create-address.bru:17-25 and commerce-platform/e2e-bruno/run-e2e.sh:133-139.

symbols.evidence: Its postalCode record component is the JSON property being renamed at account-service/src/main/java/com/poc/account/api/dto/AddressResponse.java:6-18.
It maps the persisted domain value into the renamed response component position at account-service/src/main/java/com/poc/account/infrastructure/mapping/AddressDtoMapper.java:10-16.
It exposes AddressResponse through GET list/detail and POST/PUT responses at account-service/src/main/java/com/poc/account/api/AddressController.java:45-81.
It passes address bodies and responses as JsonNode, without rebinding either field name, at commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/api/AddressProxyController.java:35-69.
The relay forwards the body unchanged and materializes responses as JsonNode at commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/infrastructure/client/DownstreamRelay.java:40-58.
The client-side response model has postalCode at commerce-web/src/api/types.ts:47-59.
It renders address.postalCode and writes addressInput.postalCode into the create-address request at commerce-web/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx:112-120.

Jackson binds Account's detail response by the postalCode component name at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/infrastructure/client/AccountClient.java:24-36; postcode is otherwise ignored and postalCode becomes null.
It copies the name-bound response.postalCode into AddressSnapshot at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/infrastructure/client/AccountClient.java:40-41.
This internal snapshot carries the null postalCode value at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/domain/model/AddressSnapshot.java:3-4.
It passes AddressSnapshot.postalCode() to the shipment port before a quote can be saved at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/application/CheckoutService.java:41-60.

Its Map.of payload construction rejects the null postalCode before an HTTP delivery-estimate request or an order.confirmed event can be emitted at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/infrastructure/client/ShipmentClient.java:30-39.

contracts.evidence: The account OpenAPI response schema declares postalCode at account-service/openapi/account.yaml:225-250. It is used by list/create/get/update responses at account-service/openapi/account.yaml:10-115; order-service binds the detail response by name at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/infrastructure/client/AccountClient.java:24-41.

Account publishes the list endpoint returning AddressResponse at account-service/openapi/account.yaml:10-23; the BFF relays GET /api/v1/addresses to account-service as JsonNode at commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/api/AddressProxyController.java:33-37 and commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/api/AddressProxyController.java:65-69.

Account publishes the AddressResponse detail endpoint at account-service/openapi/account.yaml:62-85. order-service calls it and binds its JSON response at order-service/src/main/java/com/poc/order/infrastructure/client/AccountClient.java:30-41; the BFF also relays this path through its common call method at commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/api/AddressProxyController.java:65-69.

The POST response is AddressResponse at account-service/openapi/account.yaml:24-40. The BFF forwards the JSON body and returns the raw JSON result at commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/api/AddressProxyController.java:39-44 and commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/infrastructure/client/DownstreamRelay.java:48-53.

The PUT response is AddressResponse at account-service/openapi/account.yaml:86-115. The BFF forwards this body unchanged at commerce-bff/src/main/java/com/poc/bff/api/AddressProxyController.java:49-53.
